About Qostara Estimates

Professional Estimating and Preconstruction Support

Qostara Estimates provides professional construction estimating, quantity takeoff, MEP estimating, and shop drawing services for contractors, subcontractors, builders, developers, and construction professionals.

Request an Estimate

What we do

Clear, Detailed, and Actionable Cost Information

We turn construction plans and specifications into clear, detailed, and actionable cost information—helping you understand project requirements, prepare competitive bids, and make better decisions before construction begins.

Estimating a construction project requires more than measuring quantities. It requires understanding drawings, specifications, materials, labor requirements, subcontractor scopes, and current project costs.

Our estimating team reviews your project documents, performs detailed quantity takeoffs, develops trade-specific estimates, and organizes the information into a professional bid-ready format.

Who we serve

Built for Contractors Who Need Reliable Numbers

  • General Contractors

    Prepare complete project estimates, review subcontractor scopes, and develop competitive bids.

  • Subcontractors

    Focus on your trade while we handle the quantity takeoff and estimating work behind your bid.

  • Builders & Developers

    Understand project costs earlier and use detailed estimates to support budgeting and planning.

  • Construction Professionals

    Outsource estimating when your internal team needs additional capacity or when deadlines are tight.

Project scale
